name: EVERTEC
outlook:
What EVERTEC says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueWe now expect revenue between $1,088 million and $1,096 million representing growth of approximately 16.7% to 17.6%, an increase from our previous expectation of 16.4% to 17.5%.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted earnings per shareWe now expect Adjusted earnings per common share to be between $4.00 to $4.08 representing growth of approximately 10.5% to 12.7%, an increase from our previous expectation of 8.8% to 13.8%.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDA marginWe now expect Adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 39.5%, or 40% on a constant currency basis.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresWe now expect capital expenditures to be approximately $95 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
